geeklist.title: **FINAL 48 HOURS** The "Two Brothers from Jersey want YOU to have Their Games for a Price" Auction (ends Feb 1)
geeklist.description:
[center][COLOR=#009900][b][size=28]PLEASE READ BEFORE BIDDING!!!!![/size][/b][/COLOR][/center]
This auction will end at 10:00pm EST on the evening of Sunday, Feb 1. Any bids made beyond then are null and void in the event that I am unable to close the auction at that time.
:d10-1: [u][b]ITEM LISTING INFO[/b][/u] This auction includes games and expansions/promos from my collection and the collection of mi amigo in a joint auction where I have listed all items in alphabetical order. For the games, I will list every item's edition/version even if there is only one and will list every item's condition. If you would like to see pictures of the items in question, please GM me and I will get back to you in a timely manner. Most listings will have a minimum Starting Bid and a BIN. Others will be a BIN ONLY, and a few will also only have Starting Bids. [i][size=14][b]**NOTE**[/b] All these items are cross-listed on Discord Board Game Sales lists. They may be purchased from there and will make them unavailable here.[/size][/i]
:d10-2: [u][b]BIDDING INFO[/b][/u] Please bid an amount that is equal to or higher than the Starting Bid, or bid an amount that is higher than the previous bid if there is one. Bid in whole dollar amounts. If you would like to guarantee the purchase of the item, please claim it with a BIN if there is one. Please do NOT bid on items if you do not intend on paying for them within one week of the auction closing. If I do not receive payments by that time, the bids will be considered null and void.
:d10-3: [b][u]SHIPPING INFO[/u][/b] Items can be shipped from Elizabeth, NJ (07028) at the buyer's expense. I use pirateship for the cheapest prices I can. If there is a cheaper option, I will try to accommodate. You may also request Local Pickup if you wish.
:d10-4: [b][u]TRADING INFO[/u][/b] I am looking for a very small amount of things and would be open to a trade suggestion for anything in this auction. Please reach out via GM with the suggested offer and I will get back to you as soon as I can. Take a look [geekurl=/wishlist/Squirrel_Trades][b]HERE[/b][/geekurl] to see my Wishlist.
ALL SALES WILL GO THROUGH THE BGG MARKETPLACE FOR THEIR WELL-DESERVED 3%!!!
